description: Cross-industry automation patterns applicable to all supported industries

automations.name: Automated Lead Capture → CRM
automations.trigger: New form submission, inquiry, or inbound contact
steps: Capture form submission or inquiry from website/landing page
Enrich lead data with available information (company, role, source)
Create or update contact record in CRM
Assign lead score based on source and data completeness
Trigger welcome email sequence
Notify sales team via Slack/email for high-score leads

industry_variants.dental: New patient inquiry → Open Dental/Dentrix patient record
industry_variants.ecommerce: Newsletter signup or cart abandonment → Klaviyo/Omnisend

automations.name: Automated Invoice Generation & Follow-up
automations.trigger: Service completed, order fulfilled, or billing cycle reached
steps: Detect billable event (service completion, order shipment, cycle date)
Pull line items, pricing, and customer details from source system
Generate invoice in accounting platform
Send invoice via email with payment link
Track payment status and send automated reminders (7, 14, 30 days)
Update CRM with payment status and flag overdue accounts

industry_variants.dental: Treatment completed → generate patient statement with insurance adjustment
industry_variants.ecommerce: Order shipped → generate invoice and update accounting
industry_variants.professional-services: Time entries approved → generate client invoice from billable hours
industry_variants.b2b-platforms: Usage data aggregated → generate usage-based invoice per contract tier

automations.name: Automated Email/SMS Follow-up Sequences
automations.trigger: Customer action, inaction, or time-based trigger
steps: Define trigger events (post-purchase, post-appointment, no-show, etc.)
Create message templates with personalization tokens
Set up timing rules (immediate, +1 day, +3 days, +7 days)
Configure channel preference (email vs SMS vs both)
Handle opt-outs and unsubscribe requests
Track engagement metrics (open rate, click rate, response rate)

industry_variants.dental: Post-appointment satisfaction check → recall reminder sequence
industry_variants.b2b-platforms: Onboarding milestone emails → usage tips → feature adoption nudges

automations.name: Automated Review & Feedback Collection
steps: Detect service/product delivery completion
Wait appropriate interval (1-3 days depending on industry)
Send personalized review request with direct link to preferred platform
For positive internal feedback (NPS 8+), direct to public review site
For negative feedback, route to internal follow-up for resolution
Track review volume and sentiment trends

industry_variants.dental: Post-appointment → Google Business Profile review request
industry_variants.b2b-platforms: Quarterly NPS survey → G2/Capterra review request for promoters

automations.name: Calendar & Scheduling Sync
steps: Sync booking platform with team calendars in real-time
Auto-create video conferencing link (Zoom/Google Meet) for virtual meetings
Send confirmation with all details to attendee
Update CRM with appointment record
Send reminder 24h and 1h before appointment
Handle cancellations and automatically open slot for rebooking

industry_variants.dental: Patient books online → syncs with PMS schedule → sends prep instructions
industry_variants.ecommerce: Customer books consultation → syncs with advisor calendar
industry_variants.professional-services: Client books consultation → creates matter in practice management
industry_variants.b2b-platforms: Partner books demo → syncs with sales team → creates deal in CRM

automations.name: Inventory & Stock Alerts
automations.trigger: Stock level falls below threshold or demand forecast exceeds supply
steps: Monitor inventory levels against configurable thresholds
Calculate days of supply remaining based on consumption rate
Send alert when stock reaches reorder point
Generate purchase order recommendation with suggested quantities
Track supplier lead times and adjust reorder points
Report on stockout incidents and carrying costs

industry_variants.dental: Dental supply inventory → auto-reorder from Henry Schein/Patterson
industry_variants.ecommerce: Product stock levels → Shopify inventory alerts → supplier PO
industry_variants.b2b-platforms: Spare parts inventory → predictive reorder based on IoT device usage data

automations.name: AI-Powered Support Ticket Routing
automations.trigger: New support request received via any channel
steps: Receive support request (email, chat, phone, form)
Classify ticket by category, urgency, and complexity using AI
Check knowledge base for existing answers to common questions
Auto-respond to FAQ-type queries with AI-drafted answers
Route complex tickets to appropriate team member based on expertise
Set SLA timers and escalation rules based on priority

industry_variants.dental: Patient inquiry → classify (scheduling, billing, clinical) → route accordingly
industry_variants.ecommerce: Customer support → classify (order status, returns, product question) → auto-resolve or route
industry_variants.professional-services: Client request → classify (billing, case update, new matter) → route to responsible partner
industry_variants.b2b-platforms: Support ticket → classify (device issue, billing, feature request) → route to tech/CS/product

automations.name: Automated Data Backup & Export
steps: Schedule automated data export from primary systems
Export data in standardized format (CSV, JSON, or database dump)
Encrypt and upload to secure cloud storage
Verify backup integrity with checksums
Rotate old backups per retention policy
Send confirmation notification with backup summary

industry_variants.dental: PMS patient data → encrypted backup (HIPAA-compliant storage)
industry_variants.ecommerce: Order history + customer data → GDPR-compliant backup
industry_variants.professional-services: Client files + billing data → encrypted backup with audit trail
industry_variants.b2b-platforms: IoT data + customer records → time-series backup with compliance

automations.name: Automated Reporting Dashboards
steps: Connect data sources (CRM, billing, analytics, operations)
Define KPI calculations and visualizations
Build dashboard with real-time or scheduled data refresh
Generate AI-written insights summary highlighting anomalies and trends
Distribute reports via email/Slack on schedule
Track metric trends and alert on significant changes

industry_variants.dental: Production, collections, new patients, no-show rate → weekly practice report
industry_variants.ecommerce: Revenue, AOV, conversion rate, inventory turns → daily operations report
industry_variants.professional-services: Utilization, realization, WIP, aged AR → weekly partner report
industry_variants.b2b-platforms: MRR, churn, NRR, partner pipeline → weekly exec report

automations.name: Automated Onboarding Sequences
automations.trigger: New customer, patient, or partner signs up
steps: Detect new signup or account creation
Send welcome message with getting-started guide
Trigger onboarding email sequence (Day 1, 3, 7, 14, 30)
Track feature adoption milestones and send contextual tips
Flag accounts that haven't completed key onboarding steps
Schedule check-in for accounts that are struggling

industry_variants.dental: New patient → welcome kit, insurance verification, first visit prep
industry_variants.ecommerce: New customer → welcome discount, product recommendations, loyalty program intro
industry_variants.professional-services: New client → engagement letter, portal setup, team introductions
industry_variants.b2b-platforms: New partner → portal access, training modules, first installation support

automations.name: Contract Renewal Automation
steps: Monitor contract expiration dates in CRM
Generate renewal proposal with updated pricing/terms
Send automated renewal notification sequence (90, 60, 30 days)
Prepare renewal contract with DocuSign for e-signature
Track renewal status and escalate at-risk renewals to account manager
Update billing system upon successful renewal

industry_variants.professional-services: Retainer renewal → proposal with engagement summary → e-signature
industry_variants.b2b-platforms: Subscription renewal → usage summary → right-sized tier recommendation

automations.name: Automated Expense & Receipt Processing
steps: Capture receipt via photo, email forward, or bank feed
Extract vendor, amount, date, and category using AI/OCR
Match to appropriate expense category and GL code
Auto-categorize and flag unusual expenses
Sync to accounting system for reconciliation
Generate monthly expense summary with category breakdown

industry_variants.dental: Supply purchases, lab bills, equipment costs → auto-categorize to dental expense types
industry_variants.ecommerce: Shipping costs, ad spend, platform fees → auto-categorize to COGS/marketing
industry_variants.professional-services: Client-billable expenses → auto-tag to matters for reimbursement
industry_variants.b2b-platforms: Hardware costs, field service expenses → auto-categorize to COGS/operations
